-- SQL DDL for PostgreSQL, generated by ormbridge.

CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS hstore;

CREATE TYPE mood AS ENUM ('HAPPY', 'SAD');

CREATE TABLE owners (
  id INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT owners_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE TABLE devices (
  id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  "serial" INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,
  ticket INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,
  tags VARCHAR(30)[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  grid INTEGER[][] NOT NULL,
  attrs JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  labels HSTORE,
  address INET,
  "window" INT4RANGE,
  last_seen TIMESTAMPTZ,
  retired BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  mood mood NOT NULL DEFAULT 'HAPPY',
  shape Geometry(POINT),
  owner_id INTEGER,
  CONSTRAINT devices_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT devices_ticket_key UNIQUE (ticket),
  CONSTRAINT devices_owner_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (owner_id) REFERENCES owners (id)
);
CREATE INDEX ix_devices_tags ON devices USING gin (tags);
